description: Save a new HTML artifact in Files from files you wrote, in about a second. Send files keyed by path: index.html is the page, each *.insights.json is an Insights report, and report.insights.json is the main report (Replo renders the page around it when index.html is omitted). Add CSS, scripts, data and images alongside. Saves to My Files unless parentId names another folder. Returns the artifact folder ID and its viewer link. Creation is private; call set_file_sharing with the folder ID only when the user asks to share it. To have Replo's agent research and write the artifact from a request in words, use generate_artifact instead.

description.description: The one-line summary shown on the artifact's card.

additionalProperties.description: The file's text, or { base64 } for binary files such as images and fonts. The content type comes from the extension.

files.description: The artifact's files keyed by relative path. Include index.html, report.insights.json, or both. index.html is the page. Link sibling files with relative URLs; scripts may load only from the artifact, cdnjs, jsDelivr /npm/, unpkg, the Tailwind CDN and the jQuery CDN, and other outbound requests are blocked. Each *.insights.json file is an Insights report document (version "2.0", the shape get_insights_report returns) whose saved queries run live for each viewer; embed one with <replo-report src="./sales.insights.json"></replo-report>. report.insights.json is the artifact's main report, the one the Insights report tools read, and without index.html Replo renders the page around it.

propertyNames.description: A path relative to the artifact folder, such as index.html, styles.css or images/logo.png.

parentId.description: The folder to save the artifact in, from list_files. Omit to save it in My Files.

name: create_artifact
title: Create artifact
